scale_plan.detail: research/data/pilot-v2-scale-plan.md proposes a bounded 1,000,000 unique-token first target plus 50,000 validation/test tokens, with explicitly hypothetical bytes/token ranges (not T0016 extrapolations), streaming source artifacts instead of hex blobs, compact binary and JSONL shard strategies, rights/source registry review, complete 256-byte tokenizer qualification and train-only fit, dedup/leakage policy, independent hashes/coverage audit, per-split/family budgets, test non-exposure, private storage/pins and separately reviewed acquisition/producer/CLI tasks. No acquisition, cap enlargement or production loader is implemented.

limitations: Synthetic prototype only; no actual corpus, tokenizer fit, source authenticity, legal clearance, training or evaluation.
The scale-plan byte/token ranges are hypothetical planning assumptions, not T0016 extrapolations or measured corpus statistics.
The explicit tokenizer table is not a production BPE; full 256-byte alphabet and train-only fit require separate qualification.
The dataset root is a trusted static root; reads are bounded and symlinks rejected, but no concurrent-mutation/race-proof guarantee is claimed.
v2 remains standalone and is not accepted training input; v1, CLI and configs are unchanged.
